column3: Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - found another gear inside the final furlong to hit the front and score
Settled midpack early - moved through strongly to hit the front two furlongs out - pushed along a furlong later - stayed on but was overtaken close home to finish second beaten a length
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - closed strongly late to finish third
Went straight to front - pressed for effort and lost command 2f out - gave way approaching final furlong - finished fourth
Held a midfield position - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on late without threatening - finished fifth
Held up at the back - pushed along and stayed on same speed from 2f out - finished sixth
Settled towards the back early - nudged into contention travelling wide with 2f left - dropped away soon after - eventually beaten well clear in 7th
Tracked the pace-setter early - pushed along 3f out then dropped away 2f from home - allowed to drop away last furlong
Sat handy in 5th early - up to 4th with 4f remaining - improved into 2nd over 2f out - pressed for advantage approaching the straight - hit the front a furlong out and stayed on strongly to score
Sat second early - moved to front 3f out - overtaken close home - stayed on for second
Held up at the back - began to make headway 3f out - up to 6th and pushed along entering straight - 4th and driven inside final 2f - stayed on but couldn't get to those in front
Held up at back - moved into contention 3f out - 7th and driven turning into straight - stayed on well from the final furlong to finish closest but well held in 4th
Held a spot behind the front group early - moved up to 2nd approaching 3f out then dropped back to 3rd and pushed along with 2f left - unable to close the gap in the closing stages and finished 5th
Settled behind the front group early - up to 4th and pushed along before the straight - unable to make further headway inside the final furlong finishing sixth
Held towards the back of the pack early - closed into 5th and pushed along entering the straight - unable to find more inside the final furlong and finished 7th
Settled around midpack early - dropped towards rear by halfway and still there approaching straight with little to show - held on for eighth beaten just under six lengths
Settled towards the back early - pushed along with 4f left but unable to close - held no chance in the closing stages
Held up in the pack from the off - made no headway approaching the straight - well held at the finish
Keen to go forward early - settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - dropped away with 2f and a half left to run - unable to threaten leaders and faded through the straight
Went straight to front - overtaken 3f out and quickly slipped back through the field - dropped away entering the straight - never a threat late on finishing well beaten
Held up towards the back - 9th at halfway - dropped away 4f out - struggling and outpaced into the straight - faded late finishing well held
Sat close to the front group in 4th - pushed along and dropped away with 3f left - faded turning into the straight to finish well held
Held a midfield spot early - made smooth progress 2f out - pushed along a furlong out and finished full of running - hit the front right at the line
Tracked the pace early - pushed along with two furlongs left - hit the front approaching the final furlong and stayed on strongly - caught right on the line to finish second
Went clear early - pressed for effort with 2f left before losing the front spot inside the final furlong - couldn't find more late and held for third
Settled off the front group - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - stayed on same gear through the closing stages to finish 4th
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along and made late progress from the final furlong to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - pushed along and stayed on same effort inside final furlong - finished sixth
Sluggish start - held up towards the back throughout - finished well held in 7th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 8th
Settled close to pace early - pushed to challenge inside final furlong - hit front and stayed on well to win
Settled just off the pace early - driven for effort inside final furlong - moved into second close home - narrowly denied at the line
Sat close behind the front group early - driven for effort inside final furlong - stayed on to finish third beaten a length
Went straight to front - driven along and challenged approaching final furlong - overtaken close home to finish fourth
Settled just behind the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - unable to close the gap late - finished fifth beaten 3¾ lengths
Held mid-pack early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish

Sent to front from the start - lost the advantage before halfway and settled into second - regained command 3f out - opened a three-length advantage entering the final furlong and stayed on strongly to the line

Settled around midpack early - up to 7th at the turnover point - made ground into contention 3f from home - into 3rd and driven entering the straight but unable to threaten leader - claimed 2nd close to the finish line
Sat in fourth early - pushed along and up to third with 3f left before moving into second turning for home - unable to close from there and held for third
Sat handy in 5th early - drifted to 6th 3f out then back to 5th entering straight - unable to threaten and held for 4th
Sat in third early - moved into second and pushed along 3f out before dropping to fourth turning for home - unable to close and finished well held
Held up early - improved into midfield by 3f out - unable to challenge and held for 6th before straight
Sat just behind the pace early - dropped back into midfield by halfway then slipped further behind with 4f left - unable to make headway into the straight and well held in 7th
Held up early - crept into contention around 7th approaching the straight - unable to close on the leaders in the closing stages - finished well held in 8th
Held up towards the back - roughly 8th at halfway - pushed along soon after - dropped away 3f out and never a threat
Sat second early - went to front before halfway - overtaken with 3f left - dropped away soon after - given a breather entering the straight well beaten - finished far last
Settled off the pace early - urged along with 2f left and swept to the front approaching the final furlong - drew away to score
Settled off the pace early - pushed along to close in 2f out while drifting left approaching the final furlong - kept on to move into second close home
Held a midfield spot early - pushed along and finished with steady purpose from two furlongs out to take third
Set the early gallop up front - pushed along approaching 2f out - lost the advantage inside the final furlong - stayed on same gear to finish fourth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the closing furlong - finished fifth
Sluggish start - held at the back and pushed along 2f out - shortened the gap late finishing 6th
Settled midpack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at same tempo to finish seventh
Sat close to the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish eighth
Held up early towards the back - lost touch through the middle stages - well beaten in 9th
Held up at the back throughout - never a threat - well held at the finish
Set the pace early - lost front spot inside final 2f and pushed along - fought back to the front with a furlong left - pulled clear in the closing 110 yards to prevail
Handy in the early stages - pushed into the front spot approaching 2f out - overtaken inside the final furlong - stayed on at a steady gait to finish second
Sat close behind the front group - pushed along and moved up to challenge with 2f left - stayed on at an even tempo to finish third
Settled at the rear early - pushed along with 2f left - edged into fourth close home but lacked the speed to get involved
Settled in the pack - pushed along with over 2f left - stayed on steadily but never in contention for the placings - finished 5th beaten 3¾ lengths
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along and dropped back 2f out - faded in the closing stages to finish 6th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - soon dropping away - finished 7th
Went straight to front early - challenged approaching the straight and edged clear inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Settled just behind the pace in 3rd - asked for effort approaching the straight - moved into 2nd with 200 yards left - pressed home the bid to the line - held on for second beaten half a length
Stumbled at the break - settled in the middle of the pack - moved into 4th approaching the straight - 3rd 200 yards out and in contention 100 yards out - ran on at one speed to finish third
Held up towards the back - moved into 7th turning for home - into 5th when driven a furlong out but unable to gain further ground - finished 4th staying on at one speed
Settled just behind the front group in 5th-6th - pressed for effort before the turn - unable to close in final furlong - finished 5th
Keen to go forward early - sat 4th-5th behind pace before straightening then pushed along - unable to make headway final furlong finished 6th
Settled around midfield - down in 8th at halfway - unable to close before the turn and held late finishing seventh
Settled second early behind the pace - pressed forward before entering the straight - flattened out inside final furlong to finish 8th
Settled towards the back early - unable to close on the leading group - lacked involvement in the closing stages - well held in 9th
Held up towards the back - still 10th at halfway - unable to close and stayed held up in the closing stages
Settled around midfield early - 7th at halfway - pushed along with over two and a half furlongs left - dropped back before the straight and unable to make headway to finish 11th
Held up at the back - pushed along over 2f out with no headway made - well held at the finish
Made the running at a steady tempo - pressed into action 2f out - forged decisively ahead from just outside the final furlong - won with plenty in hand
Settled midfield early - pushed along with 3f remaining - stayed on at a steady rate to move into second inside the final furlong - held on for that spot at the line
Held a midfield spot early - improved and pushed along with 3f left - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong - finished third
Sat close to leader early while pulling hard - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish fourth
Boxed in early - settled just off midfield pace pulling hard - couldn't land a blow on pace-setters and well held for fifth
Settled off the pace - nudged for effort with 4f left - dropped away 2f out - finished sixth well behind
Rider dropped a stirrup breaking from the gate - held up towards the back early - always well off the pace - finished well beaten in 7th
Settled midpack early - pressed for effort with 3f left - failed to land a blow - well held at the finish
Held up at the back throughout - never in contention - well beaten in 9th
Held up at the back - never a threat - well beaten in the end
Settled towards rear early - pushed along and dropped away 4f out - well beaten in 11th
Stayed towards the rear throughout - never able to challenge - finished a distant 12th
Settled in second early - driven up to challenge the front-runner inside the final two furlongs - took command entering the last furlong while drifting left - held on gamely to score
Sent to the front early - driven along with rival close by over a furlong out - overtaken approaching the last furlong - fought back at the winner in the closing stages - narrowly denied at the line
Settled in third early - dropped a place 2f out - pressed on to reclaim third inside final furlong - unable to trouble leading two finishing third
Settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f left - moved past faded runners inside final furlong but always well off the pace
Held fourth early - moved into third with 2f left before fading out of it under pressure inside the final furlong - dropped away to finish fifth
Sat just off the front three - asked for effort before the turn - moved into contention and hit the front a furlong out - stayed clear when pushed out - finished strongly for the win
Handy behind front group early - mid-pack around halfway then pushed along and up to 5th - moved into second inside final furlong - unable to close further - held on for the runner-up spot
Hemmed in early exit from stalls - held towards the back - up to 9th turning for home - closing steadily from the final furlong to finish third
Sat just behind the pack in 5th-7th - pushed along before the turn but unable to find extra going into the final furlong - stayed on at an even gauge to finish 4th
Settled in the pack around 8th - pushed along at halfway with little threat into the straight - found a bit of momentum before being severely checked inside the final furlong and held on for 5th
Sat close to front pack early in 4th - lost footing a touch approaching final two furlongs - drifted right when driven inside final 150 yards still 4th - unable to threaten and finished 6th
Held up at the back - responded in the closing stages without threatening the front - finished seventh
Tracked front group early - up to 4th nearing straight before easing back with a furlong left - hampered inside the final 100 yards and unable to fight back - finished eighth well beaten

Tracked front pair early while dealing with slipped tack - rider without stirrups soon after start - hit the front around 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong - unable to find more - hampered hard around 100 yards from home - finished 9th well beaten
Went straight to the front early - lost the advantage two furlongs out and found little more when asked - fading and then significantly hampered inside the final furlong to finish well beaten in 10th
Held up in touch with back markers - unable to make headway in the straight - well held throughout - finished 11th
Held up towards the back - dropped away entering the straight - never a factor - finished well down the field
Settled midfield early - moved through smoothly from 2f out - driven and kept finding more from inside the final furlong to hit the front - eased clear late to score
Settled off the pace early - pushed into contention approaching final furlong and burst to the front - overtaken close home - battled on for second
Tracked front group wide of rivals - pressed for effort a furlong out - stayed on at one gear to finish third
Sat close to pace early - pushed clear at the furlong pole - lost momentum near the finish - beaten 2.75 lengths in 4th
Settled off the pace early - pushed along with 2f left and closed on the front group - unable to find more inside the final furlong
Settled towards the back early - nudged into a slight advance approaching 2f out - pushed along but unable to find more from inside the final furlong - well beaten in 6th
Held slim advantage early - pressed for effort 2f out and lost front spot - dropped away rapidly inside final furlong
Sluggish getaway - settled near back - pushed along with 2f left and unable to feature
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished ninth
Sluggish start - inexperienced and towards the back throughout - well held in 10th
Sluggish start - stayed at the back of the field throughout - well held at the finish
Asked for effort early to sit in the pack - under pressure and dropped away 3f out - well held at the finish
Held back early towards the back - eased and pulled up with more than 3f left to run
Handy in the pack early - pushed to go on inside final furlong - hit front and stayed on strongly to win
Settled just off the pace early - pushed along past the furlong marker - gained ground in the closing stages - nabbed second right at the line
Sat close to the front - pushed along to bid over 1f out - stayed on same gear to finish third
Sent clear early - pushed along and chased over a furlong out - lost the advantage in the last furlong - stayed on for 4th
Went eagerly early - sat fourth through the race - asked for effort a furlong out and pressed into contention - stayed on at one speed to finish fifth
Held second and shared the lead early - went clear with a determined ride a furlong out - stayed on strongly to score
Sat behind the front group in 5th - moved into 3rd turning for home - pushed into the lead battle late on - stuck on for second beaten a length
Sat behind front group in 3rd-4th - pushed along entering straight - back to 3rd and pushed to lead 150 yards out - held position and stayed on to finish 3rd
Sat close to the front pack in 4th-5th early - unable to find extra when asked entering final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish 4th
Shared front spot early - lost command inside final furlong - unable to find more when asked - finished 5th beaten 3½ lengths
Sat close up in 6th early - made ground into straight - unable to threaten front pair inside final furlong - finished 6th
Held up at the back - still down in ninth at halfway with little progress made - made no headway in the straight and finished well held
Held up at the back after a sluggish getaway - down the field passing halfway - unable to progress into the straight - well held to finish 8th
Slow into stride - settled towards the back and still last by halfway - unable to make headway into the straight - well held at the finish
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - roughly 8th at halfway - edged forward approaching straight but soon held no threat
Sat behind the front group early - 7th at halfway with little threat entering the straight - dropped away soon after finishing 11th
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left before surging clear inside final furlong - kept up the fight to the line
Sat close to front early - pushed along with 2f left - kept finding under pressure through the closing stages - denied by a length
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - kept on well through the last furlong to close best of all
Held up at the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - finished strongly from the final furlong to take 4th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f to run - stayed on at one speed inside the closing furlong - finished 5th beaten 2 lengths
Held slim advantage in a modest gallop early - pressed for effort and lost the front spot with under a furlong to run - faded fast close home to finish sixth
Settled towards the back - pushed along and stayed on at one gear over 2f out - always outpaced
Tracked the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - fading when knocked sideways inside the last furlong - eventually beaten 6.5 lengths in 8th
Shared front spot early - clear of rivals from 1f - roused approaching final furlong - held on under late pressure to score
Settled in rear - driven 2f out - made ground over 1f out - finished with real purpose to claim second near the line - went down by a short head
mid-pack early - moved through the field 2f out - pushed into second with a furlong left and challenged the leader inside the final 110yds - edged out for the runner-up spot late to finish third
Sat close to front group early - pressed for effort inside final furlong - stayed on without extra finishing 4th
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - finished fifth
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm in the pack - urged forward with two furlongs left - unable to make real headway - finished sixth beaten 6½ lengths
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - unable to respond and beaten off - finished 7th
Shared front spot early - dropped back into the pack before 2f out - pushed along and faded fast finishing eighth
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along approaching the final 2f - made no impression thereafter - finished well beaten in 9th
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f to run - always struggling to get involved - well beaten at the finish
Sat handy in 3rd early - improved into 2nd approaching 2f out - hit the front with a furlong left after asking for effort in straight - stayed on to win

Sat just off the front group in 5th - up to 4th past halfway - into 3rd as the race intensified nearing the straight - moved into 2nd and pressed on 200 yards out - stayed on to finish second by a short head margin
Went straight to front - challenged nearing the straight - overtaken with a furlong left and dropped to third - stayed on at an even effort to finish
Sat close to the pace in 4th - slipped to the rear after halfway and stayed there under pressure - unable to make ground into the straight finishing fourth beaten 5¾ lengths
Sat just behind the pacesetter early - dropped back with over two furlongs left - faded into fourth turning for home and fell away late
Sat behind pace early - travelling smoothly with two out - improved to hit front approaching final furlong - eased clear to win easily
Held up early - pushed along with 3f left - finished strongly over the last furlong to snatch runner-up spot near the line
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - moved up to press the leader with a furlong to run - flattened out and edged out of the places near the line

Sluggish to find rhythm early and unsettled - settled towards the back - urged along with 2f left - progress made to reach the front group inside the final furlong and a half - unable to find more in the closing stages
Clear early advantage - pushed along 2f out - lost command inside final furlong - dropped away late
Held in the pack early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away 2f out - finished sixth
Tracked front group early - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped away 2f out - finished seventh
Settled towards the rear early - pushed along with 2f to go - dropped away fast inside the final furlong - finished eighth

Handy early behind the front group - given a squeeze up 3f out - made smooth progress 2f out - lost momentum briefly a furlong out - roused to fight back inside the final furlong - got up close home to win
Set the pace early - challenged for the lead over 2f out - urged forward approaching the final furlong then lost the riding aid - overtaken close to the line - edged out in a tight finish
Broke on terms and sat close up - shadowing the front-runner into the straight - asked for effort a furlong out - poised to strike inside the final furlong - held level through the line for third
Tracked the front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left - driven but faded inside the final furlong - finished fourth
Held a forward spot early - came under pressure and lost ground inside final 2f - eventually held 5th
Pulled hard early - settled towards the back - driven up 3f out - unable to threaten leaders 2f out and dropped away
Settled at the back early - pushed forward before 3f out - dropped away and beaten off the pace inside final 2f

Settled behind the front group early - up to 7th by halfway - moving through into 5th turning for home - hit the front approaching the final furlong and edged ahead close home - stayed on strongly to score
Tracked the pace group - 5th at halfway - moved into 3rd approaching the straight - hit the front a furlong out - overtaken close home - stayed on to the line
Settled in the pack early - 8th at halfway - up to 7th entering the straight - unable to make ground with a furlong left - stayed on late to snatch 3rd close home
Sat behind the front group - 6th at halfway - pushed along before the turn - into 5th but unable to make headway a furlong out and held on for fourth
Sluggish start - settled near back - 10th at halfway - improved to 8th when asked for effort in straight - unable to make further headway inside final furlong - stayed on to finish fifth
Second early and shared the front spot - dropped into a tight fourth as the finish neared - held the same pace to the line - finished sixth beaten 4 lengths
Tracked the front group early - 4th at halfway - hampered for room approaching the straight - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 7th
Shared front spot early - lost command with a furlong left as effort was squeezed - held no more in reserve late - finished eighth beaten 6¼ lengths
Held up in the pack early - still 9th at halfway and pushed along with no headway made - unable to threaten in the straight and beaten home
Held up in the pack - still 11th at halfway - unable to close and well held throughout
Sluggish getaway - stayed at the rear throughout and lost more ground 3f out - never a threat late
Held up at the back - bumped early then lost touch before halfway - never a factor and well held in 12th
Sat close to the front pair early - dropped away with three furlongs left - beaten well before the turn for home
Handy behind the front group early - pulled up after 1f
Tracked front group early - moved left and pushed along 2f out then surged clear approaching final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line
Settled midpack early - pushed along 3f out then closed on the front group with a furlong left - finished strongly to go down by three-quarters of a length
Sluggish start - moved into contention behind the front group after a furlong then pushed along 2f out - finished strongly over the final furlong to take third
Set the early gallop in front - pushed along with two furlongs left - overtaken a furlong out - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Sluggish start leaving field trailing - made progress from 2f out - pushed on and stayed on late to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at same effort late without threatening
Asked for effort early settling midfield - urged into contention 4f out - lost ground inside final furlong - finished seventh
Set off in touch with the front-runner - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - dropped away inside the final furlong
Settled around midfield - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong - finished ninth beaten 7 lengths
Sat close to the pace - wide throughout - pressed for effort and dropped away with 2f left - well held at the finish
Settled towards the back early - roused approaching 4f out and gained ground into contention 2f out - hit the front soon after - stayed on strongly in the closing stages to win
Tracked pace-setter - pushed clear 2f out but soon overtaken - lost momentum in final 110yds
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and slipped to the back approaching 2f out - allowed to drop away and well beaten at the finish

Settled towards the back early - roused along over 2f out - angled right and began closing steadily inside the final 2f - well placed with a furlong left - pushed to the front inside the closing furlong - sprinted away close home to win comfortably
Tracked the front-runner early - urged forward approaching final 2f - dropped to third but rallied under a furlong out - regained second close home - held no answer to winner in the end
Pulled hard early - up with the front group - niggled into second over 1f out - hit the front inside the final furlong before fading - third at the line
Settled with the pack early - dropped away over 2f out then pushed along and stayed on from inside the final furlong - never a factor to the front runners
Pulled hard early - jumped straight to the front and built a strong lead - pressure told 2f out and the gap shrank markedly - passed and faded sharply inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - pushed for effort with 2f left but found nothing and dropped away inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 6th
Set off in front early - asked for effort 2f out and opened a two length advantage entering the last furlong - stayed on to score
Sat close to leader early - pressed for effort with 2f left and two down at the furlong marker - held on well to finish second beaten 1¾ lengths
Handy early with front group - pressed for effort 2f out and up to third inside final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish third
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on late to grab fourth inside final 110yds
Settled off the pace in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on late to finish 5th beaten 4 lengths
Handy up front early - pushed along with 2f left then dropped a place inside final furlong - weakened quickly after finishing 6th
Held up early - never in contention - beaten off throughout - finished seventh
Fought for control early - settled off the pace till pushed along with 2f left - lost ground close home
Settled towards the back - driven into contention with a swift move a furlong out - hit the front close home to score
Handy in the early stages - driven to the front a furlong out - overtaken in the last furlong before fighting back at the winner - unable to get on terms close home and beaten 2 1/4 lengths in second
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - closed strongly inside final furlong to take third close home - finished well
Settled towards the back early - pushed along with two to go - work still needed a furlong out - finished well to snatch fourth late
Settled in the pack early - urged forward to press the leading group with 2f left and briefly went for it inside the final furlong and a half - lost momentum in the closing stages to finish 5th
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong - came home sixth
Sent to front early - driven for effort inside final two furlongs before losing the advantage - drifted left and dropped away close home - eventually beaten well over 13 lengths in 7th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away soon after - eventually beaten well home in 8th
Settled in the pack early - lost touch with the field over 2f out - well held at the finish
Held mid-pack early - pressed for effort inside final furlong close up with front group - found extra to hit the front near the line
Chased the front rank - urged along 2f out - moved up to go ahead inside the final 110yds - just outstayed near the line to finish second
Sat close up early - driven approaching final two furlongs - edged in front briefly entering last furlong - flattened out and gave way to two rivals close home
Sat close to pace early - nudged into command approaching final furlong then asked for more with 110yds left - flattened out and edged back to finish fourth
Settled at back early - pushed along a furlong out - responded late to take fifth close home
Settled towards the back - pushed along and dropped away over 2f out - responded final furlong but yielded fifth close to the line
Broke well and went straight to front - pressed throughout and pushed along with 2f left - lost command approaching final furlong and dropped away
Held up in rear from the start - never able to challenge - well held at the finish
Close to the front pack early - pushed along and lost ground inside final furlong - finished ninth
Settled just behind the pace early - asked for effort with much ground to make up two out - closing steadily inside the final furlong and drifting slightly left - got up in the last strides to score

Settled in the pack early - pushed along to move into third over 2f out - rallied into second and knocked about approaching the final furlong - edged in front close home only to be caught right on the line
Handy in the pack early - roused to the front a furlong out and pushed clear - clipped the rail inside the final 110 yards cutting the margin - caught close to the line - held on for third
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort 2f out and lost command inside the final furlong - dropped away in the closing stages to finish fourth
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward with over 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 5th
Settled in behind leaders - pushed along with 2f left - unable to land a challenge - finished sixth
Sat close to the front early - shaken up to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Pulled hard early - settled in the pack - pushed along 2f out - moved up to pursue the front group over 1f out - found extra to claim second inside the final 110yds but second best on the day
Sent forward under urging to take command - challenged hard for the front two out before being overtaken approaching the final furlong - weakened close home to finish third
fidgety before the off - travelled close to the front - pushed along and slipped to fourth inside final furlong then held on for fourth
Sluggish start - trailed the field throughout - finished well held in 5th
Fought for control early - never came close to the front - trailed home in 6th
Settled at back early - improved wide approaching last two furlongs - pressed for effort with a furlong left - hit front inside final 110yds and kept driving to the line
settled towards the back - driven up and drifted left approaching the final furlong - gained ground close home to take second - couldn't quite get to the winner
Held a central position early - urged forward with two furlongs left before responding well in the closing stages - grabbed third close home
Tracked the pace up front - pushed along a furlong out and hit the front briefly - lost the advantage inside the final 110yds - held on for fourth without finding more
Settled in the pack - pushed along to close in with a furlong left then drifted left and clipped a nearby runner - unable to find more inside the final 110 yards finishing fifth
Set the pace early - pushed along and challenged with a furlong left before losing command inside the final furlong - lost more ground close home to finish sixth
Held a spot near the front - pushed along to challenge with a furlong left - knocked about as fading strongly and beaten home in 7th
Sat close to front group early - pushed along with over a furlong left - boxed in for space and dropped away finishing 8th
Settled just off the pace early - pushed along with a furlong left - squeezed for space at the same point - unable to threaten and beaten well into 9th
Sat close to the front early - eased into command with two furlongs left and driven clear approaching the final furlong - held the advantage to the line under continued urging
Up with the front group - moved into contention 2f out - challenged the winner over 1f out and stuck on - just denied by half a length at the line

Sluggish start - quickly settled into a forward position - eased back to fourth two out before angling right to press the front group entering the final furlong - stayed on at one level to finish third
Settled in the pack - pushed along and steered right two out - drifted right approaching final furlong - stayed on for fourth without threatening the front
